question: How long does SEO take in the Philippines?
answer: Technical fixes and page improvements can show movement within weeks. Most campaigns need 3 to 6 months before the change is clear, and competitive markets often need 6 to 12. Four things set the pace: the technical condition of the site today, how strong the competing pages are, how much content has to be written, and how quickly recommendations are approved and implemented on your side.

question: Do you only work with Philippine businesses?
answer: No. We are based in Quezon City and work with businesses in the Philippines, the UK, the US, Australia and New Zealand, and with agencies that need white-label SEO support. Each market has its own page explaining how we handle it: UK, USA, Australia and New Zealand. The proposal states the billing currency.

question: Can you improve leads without just chasing more traffic?
answer: Yes. Where a site already has visitors, the quicker gain is often on the page they land on. We review the service pages, calls to action, trust signals, forms, mobile experience, internal links and conversion tracking, so the traffic you already have has a better chance of becoming calls, quote requests and enquiries. Whether to do this before or alongside ranking work is one of the things the preliminary review decides.

question: How do you measure SEO success?
answer: We track rankings, Search Console clicks and impressions, organic traffic and landing page performance, then calls, forms and Google Business Profile actions, and revenue indicators where you can share them. Reports keep search visibility, tracked actions and confirmed business outcomes separate, and list the work completed and what should happen next. Our case studies follow the same rule: they report search clicks and say plainly when sales are not shown.

question: Do you help with AI search and Google AI Overviews?
answer: Yes. We work as an AI search agency on top of SEO: crawlable pages, clear entities, useful answers, proof and authority. We have published five AI referral reviews among our case studies. We do not promise citations, because no agency can control them. See our AI search services if that is the brief.

question: What happens after I request an audit?
answer: We usually reply within one business day. We then review your website, rankings, competitors, technical setup and conversion path, and identify the highest-impact SEO and CRO opportunities. If there is a fit, you receive a written proposal for the narrowest sensible next step: a diagnostic with a 90-day roadmap, migration or recovery support, an AI search assessment, or an ongoing programme. We scope a practical roadmap and do not push you into a generic package.

question: Do you offer white-label SEO?
answer: Yes. We support agencies with confidential white-label SEO delivery: audits, content, technical SEO, reporting and campaign execution. Client communication and branding are agreed before work begins, and client contact stays with your agency unless we both agree otherwise. Our white label SEO page includes a sample handoff.
